title: Product Roadmap Status
subtitle: Q1 2026 delivery progress for Acme Commerce

items.title: Multi-currency checkout
items.description: Support USD, EUR, GBP with real-time FX conversion at checkout
items.notes: Launched Jan 5. Using OpenExchangeRates API with 1hr cache. Conversion accuracy verified against 3 providers.

items.title: Abandoned cart recovery
items.description: Automated email sequence for carts abandoned at checkout
items.notes: Email templates done. SendGrid integration complete. Waiting on marketing team for copy review and A/B test setup.

items.title: Subscription billing engine
items.description: Recurring payments with Stripe Billing, dunning management, and proration
items.notes: Stripe Billing API integrated. Dunning email flow in progress. Need to build admin UI for subscription management.

items.title: Product reviews and ratings
items.description: Customer review system with photo uploads, helpful votes, and seller responses

items.title: Advanced search with filters
items.description: Faceted search with price range, brand, category, and attribute filters

items.title: Mobile app push notifications
items.description: Order updates, price drop alerts, and back-in-stock notifications via FCM
items.notes: Shipped to production Jan 12. 34% opt-in rate. Open rate at 22%, above industry average of 18%.

items.title: B2B wholesale portal
items.description: Tiered pricing, bulk ordering, NET-30 payment terms for business customers
items.notes: Blocked on legal review of NET-30 terms. Need credit check integration before proceeding. ETA: 2 weeks.

items.title: Analytics dashboard
items.description: Revenue, conversion, AOV, and cohort analysis charts for admins

items.title: Wishlist and price drop alerts
items.description: Save items for later, get notified when price drops below threshold

items.title: Tax automation (Avalara)
items.description: Real-time tax calculation and filing automation for US and EU

items.title: GraphQL API for mobile
items.description: Migrate mobile client from REST to GraphQL for reduced payload and better caching

items.title: Customer support chat widget
items.description: In-app live chat with agent routing and canned responses
